positions.title: Technology and Innovation Fellow - Cohort 9
positions.description:
Colorwave is a community-driven organization focused on fostering equity and inclusivity within the innovation economy. Launched by a group of founders, VCs, and industry leaders, Colorwave bridges the gap for underrepresented professionals by providing access to opportunities in the venture-backed ecosystem.

Through its flagship 8-week fellowship, Colorwave empowers fellows to navigate the startup and innovation landscape with confidence. Fellows engage in 4-6 hours of weekly learning, hands-on workshops, and intimate sessions led by top VCs, entrepreneurs, tech executives, and career coaches. The program equips underrepresented talent with the knowledge, network, and insights needed to thrive in high-growth environments. 

Part of a cohort of 60+ individuals selected from a highly competitive pool with a 15% acceptance rate. The fellowship brings together a diverse group of highly motivated, intelligent individuals from various backgrounds, all committed to furthering their careers through education, networking, and personal growth.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Created scalable and efficient system architectures, optimized performance, and ensured long-term stability.

- Served as part of the account for Limited Distribution Networks on Pharmacy Drop Down Lists (Tech Lead). Team of 2-3 people. Helped Architect and develop an API route and new Application Input Search for an app with over 153 active users per 5 minutes. Oversaw project lifecycle from ideation to production. Gathered requirements from Product, UX and other stakeholders. Documented work and how-to guide for Product, SRE’s and Tech Specialists. Architecture, testing development, CI/CD pipelines, database development.

- Integrated Consul Mesh for Multiple Apps (Tech Lead). Team of 3-4 people. Limited traffic traversing from the Load Balancer (F5) to Consul in 30+ client files during PA (Blizzard) Season. Increased Consul Mesh traffic flow from 0% to ~60% in all 4 apps. Gathered expectations from multiple dev teams, analytics, and engineering director. Coordinated architecture, testing, CI/CD, data monitoring.

- Oversaw Software Developer Projects. Team of 5-10 people. Developed and deployed code for 5+ core apps serving 1.5 million monthly users. Helped iterate and build out modular workflow for 6 apps. Worked with Product and UX to experiment and iterate for 20+ multi-faceted epics. Orchestrated 50+ Code Reviews for devs from multiple teams.

- Managed SCRUM, and led stand ups monthly. Helped with card creation/prioritization/refinement.

- Served as AMP-Cop-Doc Representative for team: 5-6 people. Discussed best practices for documenting our apps to various teams. Created an Architectural Design Record for an app with 105k monthly users.

- Utilized following technologies: Ruby on Rails, PHP, ActiveRecord, Rspec, Docker, Backbone.js, Coffee Script, Vue.js, Jira, Confluence, React, Lucid Chart, Node.js, Sentry, Splunk, Grafana, Kubernetes, Datadog
positions.insights: Skills: Ruby on Rails · HashiCorp · Docker Products · GraphQL · Elixir · Vue.js · Kubernetes

honors.title: Golden Tripod Award - Best Story
honors.description:
Campus MovieFest was founded in 2001 by four then-students at Emory University. Over the last 15 years, CMF has grown to give more than one million students access to all of the equipment and training they need to make a five-minute film in one week, including Apple laptops loaded with Adobe Creative Cloud, Panasonic HD Cameras, state-of-the-art sound equipment from Sennheiser, and external hard drives—all for free.

Students at over 30 participating colleges and universities compete, with each school hosting its own red-carpet finale event to showcase its top films. The best of the best move on to the Campus MovieFest Grand Finale, a jam-packed weekend dedicated to celebrating the creativity of young filmmakers around the globe. Awards are presented for overall Best Picture, Best Director, Best Story, and - for the first time ever - Best Sound, along with many other special CMF Golden Tripod Awards.
honors.issuer: Issued by Campus Movie Fest · Apr 2016

Welcome to iM Bored Chrome Extension. An extension that stops you from taking too long of a distraction from work. First set the timer and click on a new tab. Once the timer is up, you are logged out of that tab and back to the tab you working on!

React, Chrome Extension
